key_insight: Fit-LRP tightens neural network verification bounds by optimizing affine relaxations over exact unions of polytopes rather than loose axis-aligned bounding boxes.
engineering_relevance: It supports verification over oblique and non-convex regions arising in reachability, obstacle avoidance, and neural Lyapunov certification.
method: Represent non-convex verification domains as unions of polytopes.
Optimize affine bounds over these domains using small, low-dimensional linear programs.
Integrate with the final bound-optimization step of LiRPA and α,β-CROWN branch-and-bound to enable earlier pruning.
evidence_signal: On ARCH-COMP and neural Lyapunov benchmarks, the abstract reports 47× less branching on the hardest region, 15× lower worst-case verification time, and—with region-wise partitioning—6.1× faster verification on one CPU than α,β-CROWN on a GPU.
watch_item: Exact domain optimization does not make the neural network relaxation exact; scalability may depend on domain dimension and the number of polytopes.
paper_title: Fit-LRP: Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes for Neural Network Verification over Non-Convex Regions
